items.title: Pay locksmith call-out invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten um Ausgleich innerhalb einer Woche, nachdem Ihnen diese Rechnung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: The invoice sets no fixed date and prints no invoice date; the payment period is one week after the invoice 'zugegangen' (received). For an on-site locksmith call-out the invoice is typically handed over at the time of service, so receipt is taken as the service date, Sunday 06.12.2026 (an assumption, not stated in the letter). Under §187(1) BGB the day of receipt is not counted, so the week starts 07.12.2026; one week later (§188(1),(2) BGB) falls on Sunday 13.12.2026. As that is a Sunday, under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 14.12.2026.

warnings: The invoice has no printed invoice date and does not state when it was handed to or received by the customer; the due date of 2026-12-14 assumes receipt on the service date (06.12.2026, a Sunday), which is an assumption, not a fact stated in the letter — confirm the actual hand-over/receipt date if in doubt.

The IBAN DE43 3705 0198 0004 4002 40 is well-formed, but before paying, confirm the account belongs to this company (e.g. via the phone number or email on the letterhead) rather than relying on the letter alone.

Before transferring, check that your bank's mandatory payee-name verification (Empfängerprüfung) confirms a match for 'Schlüsseldienst Beispiel 24h' on this IBAN; if it reports no match, do not pay until confirmed.
